```{r}
# install.packages(c("rvest","stringr","dplyr","purrr","lubridate","quantmod","tibble","xts"))
library(rvest)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(quantmod)
library(tibble)
library(xts)

# -----------------------------
# Helpers: parse meeting headings (historical pages)
# -----------------------------
.parse_end_date_from_heading <- function(heading, year) {
  s <- heading %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
    str_remove("\\s*Meeting\\s*-\\s*\\d{4}\\s*$") %>%
    str_remove_all("\\(.*?\\)") %>%
    str_trim()

  if (!str_detect(s, "-")) {
    return(suppressWarnings(mdy(paste(s, year))))
  }

  parts <- str_split(s, "-", n = 2, simplify = TRUE)
  left  <- str_trim(parts[1])
  right <- str_trim(parts[2])

  start_month <- str_extract(left, "^[A-Za-z]+")
  if (str_detect(right, "^[A-Za-z]+")) {
    end_month <- str_extract(right, "^[A-Za-z]+")
    end_day   <- str_extract(right, "\\d{1,2}$")
  } else {
    end_month <- start_month
    end_day   <- str_extract(right, "\\d{1,2}")
  }

  suppressWarnings(mdy(paste(end_month, end_day, year)))
}

.get_meetings_historical_year <- function(year) {
  url <- sprintf("https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomchistorical%d.htm", year)
  pg <- read_html(url)

  h <- pg %>%
    html_elements("h5") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

  h <- h[str_detect(h, "Meeting\\s*-\\s*\\d{4}\\s*$")]

  if (length(h) == 0) {
    return(tibble(meeting_date = as.Date(character()), source_year = integer()))
  }

  tibble(
    meeting_date = as.Date(map(h, ~ .parse_end_date_from_heading(.x, year)) |> unlist()),
    source_year  = year
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(meeting_date)) %>%
    distinct(meeting_date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(meeting_date)
}

.get_meetings_from_calendar_page <- function(year) {
  url <- "https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm"
  txt <- read_html(url) %>% html_text(trim = TRUE)

  start_pat <- sprintf("%d\\s+FOMC Meetings", year)
  end_pat   <- sprintf("%d\\s+FOMC Meetings", year - 1)

  start_pos <- str_locate(txt, start_pat)[1, 1]
  if (is.na(start_pos)) return(tibble(meeting_date = as.Date(character()), source_year = integer()))

  sub <- str_sub(txt, start_pos)
  end_pos <- str_locate(sub, end_pat)[1, 1]
  if (!is.na(end_pos)) sub <- str_sub(sub, 1, end_pos - 1)

  rx <- "(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December|Jan/Feb|Feb/Mar|Mar/Apr|Apr/May|May/Jun|Jun/Jul|Jul/Aug|Aug/Sep|Sep/Oct|Oct/Nov|Nov/Dec|Dec/Jan)\\s+(\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}\\*?)"
  m <- str_match_all(sub, rx)[[1]]
  if (nrow(m) == 0) return(tibble(meeting_date = as.Date(character()), source_year = integer()))

  month_label <- m[, 2]
  day_range   <- m[, 3] %>% str_remove("\\*")

  end_day <- str_extract(day_range, "(?<=-)\\d{1,2}") %>% as.integer()

  end_month <- map_chr(month_label, function(ml) {
    if (str_detect(ml, "/")) str_split(ml, "/", simplify = TRUE)[2] else ml
  })

  month_map <- c(Jan="January", Feb="February", Mar="March", Apr="April", May="May", Jun="June",
                 Jul="July", Aug="August", Sep="September", Oct="October", Nov="November", Dec="December")
  end_month_full <- ifelse(end_month %in% names(month_map), month_map[end_month], end_month)

  tibble(
    meeting_date = as.Date(mdy(paste(end_month_full, end_day, year))),
    source_year  = year
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(meeting_date)) %>%
    distinct(meeting_date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(meeting_date)
}

# -----------------------------
# 1) Get FOMC decision dates (rows = meeting decision date)
# -----------------------------
meet_82_20 <- map_dfr(1982:2020, .get_meetings_historical_year)
meet_21_26 <- map_dfr(2021:2026, .get_meetings_from_calendar_page)

meetings <- bind_rows(meet_82_20, meet_21_26) %>%
  arrange(meeting_date) %>%
  distinct(meeting_date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(meeting_date <= as.Date("2026-03-31"))

# -----------------------------
# 2) Pull target series and create one "target level" series
# -----------------------------
getSymbols(c("DFEDTAR","DFEDTARL","DFEDTARU"), src = "FRED")

cutover <- as.Date("2008-12-16")

df_tar <- tibble(
  date   = as.Date(index(DFEDTAR)),
  target = as.numeric(DFEDTAR$DFEDTAR)
) %>% filter(!is.na(target))

df_rng <- tibble(
  date  = as.Date(index(DFEDTARL)),
  lower = as.numeric(DFEDTARL$DFEDTARL),
  upper = as.numeric(DFEDTARU$DFEDTARU)
) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(lower) | is.na(upper))) %>%
  transmute(date = date, target = (lower + upper) / 2)

target_daily <- bind_rows(
  df_tar %>% filter(date < cutover),
  df_rng %>% filter(date >= cutover)
) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE)

target_xts <- xts(target_daily$target, order.by = target_daily$date)
first_target_date <- min(target_daily$date)

get_target_asof <- function(d) {
  if (d < first_target_date) return(NA_real_)
  x <- target_xts[paste0("/", d)]
  if (NROW(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(last(x))
}

# Option A (recommended): drop meetings before target data exists
meetings2 <- meetings %>% filter(meeting_date >= first_target_date)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Build meeting-level dataset
# -----------------------------
fomc_target <- meetings2 %>%
  mutate(target = map_dbl(meeting_date, get_target_asof)) %>%
  arrange(meeting_date) %>%
  mutate(
    delta = target - lag(target),
    label = case_when(
      is.na(delta) ~ NA_character_,
      delta > 0    ~ "hike",
      delta < 0    ~ "cut",
      TRUE         ~ "hold"
    )
  )

fomc_target
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

fomc_target_no_label <- fomc_target %>% select(-label)

write.csv(
  fomc_target_no_label,
  file = "fomc_target_1982_2026M03_meeting_rows.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


getwd()
list.files(pattern = "fomc_target_1982_2026M03_meeting_rows.csv")
```
